newsitem.title: USA: Texaco shares slide in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: Texaco shares slide in thin volume.

text.p: Texaco Inc shares were down 2-3/8 to 100-3/8 in thin late-morning trade after the stock was dropped from the Dow Jones Industrial Average, but analysts say the fundamentals of the stock remain intact.

"There are some fears that the stock may not be sought after by some of the index funds, but long term the fundamentals will win out and the stock can rebound," said Bruce Lanni, an analyst at Oppenheimer & Co.
Some 512,000 Texaco shares had changed hands at 1112 EST/1612 GMT.
"There are very positive fundamentals relative to the (energy) group," said Lanni. "Volume at the moment is nothing, so you are not getting any major shareholders pulling out."
